title: Public Alert No.019/2026 – Alert on Mop up of all Otrivin Nasal Drops (0.05% and 0.1%)
summary: NAFDAC warns of counterfeit and unregistered Otrivin Nasal Drops (0.05% children and 0.01% adult) circulating in Nigeria. GlaxoSmithKline confirmed it is not currently importing the product, so all products in circulation are counterfeit. Mop-up and surveillance ordered.
